description: This file defines an Android activity 'MatrixPaletteActivity' that initializes an OpenGL surface view and sets a renderer for rendering matrix palette graphics.

classes.name: MatrixPaletteActivity
classes.description: An Android activity demonstrating how to set up an OpenGL ES rendering surface with a custom renderer.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the GLSurfaceView and assigns the renderer.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Handles activity resume and resumes the GLSurfaceView rendering.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Handles activity pause and pauses the GLSurfaceView rendering.
